name: Maria Taichi
source:
The protagonist. Kinda gloomy, but a nice person. Pretty quiet too.

Likes: Meteorology, weather maps, books, starry skies, quiet places

Dislikes: Noisy things, greasy food (like badly-made tempura), meat, being on cleaning duty at school
